name: State/municipal RFP — no FAR, different vocabulary
notes: Labels quote the document, not a paraphrase — the matcher requires containment, so a label with words the document does not carry fails the extraction rather than testing it. Deliberately unlike the federal case: no uniform contract format, no FAR clauses, percentages written as (50%) rather than 'weighted 50 percent', PASSPort and MWBE instead of SAM.gov and small business set-asides. A sweep tuned only on federal phrasing scores badly here, which is the point of keeping this case.

obligation.quote: Proposers shall have completed a minimum of three (3) similar engagements
The Proposer must maintain an active registration in PASSPort
Proposers are required to hold all licenses
Proposals shall be submitted in three parts
Each part shall be uploaded to PASSPort
Proposers shall certify their MWBE status
The Contractor may not export, process, access or store City Data
The Contractor is responsible for adhering to the City's IT security policies

instruction.quote: Proposers must complete the MWBE Utilization Plan

certification.quote: Proposers shall certify their MWBE status
